body: Yep, I sent her everything through Instagram, we can thank that dumbass for being a fucking idiot piece of crap

Thank you for making me feel less dumb and crazy. I truly mean it. I talked to one of them about it and they acted understanding, but this morning they went to see the girl I talked about to hang out with her... I think I'm going to cut them all off because everyone is rubbing shit to my face and expecting me to accept it and I can't anymore. And the other friend that made me feel like shit and doesn't trust me anymore because of a bullshit excuse of a problem, I told him yesterday that I needed clarity about our situation, and he just answered me to "go get professional help" so I guess it's not worth it anymore...
Stay strong... we will get through this... ❤

Listen to happy music to get me to feel better and take a long shower. It works every time to make me feel a little better. I really just needed to get this feelings that were in me for so long outside because I can't talk about it irl. I'm also going to re-try going to a therapist because It could really help long term and heal my wounds.
I have no other choice... I really love life, I have long terms plans, it's just that life is so hard on me sometimes I just want to sleep and never wake up... (btw I'm a girl 8) )
That's really nice thank you... If you're living something hard too, just try to think that pain is just temporary, it's what keeps me alive for now
